rule:
Receipts rule v1
1. A row is one (day, agent_code, target, client_key, tier). day is the WAT (UTC+1) calendar date.
2. client_key = first 16 hex chars of HMAC-SHA256(daily_salt, client_address + "\n" + user_agent). daily_salt is secret and changes every day; addresses and user agents are never stored.
3. tier = "bot" if the user agent matches the published known_bot pattern (/api/v1/counting-rules), else "human". human means only "not a known bot".
4. opens = number of GET requests to /r/<agent_code>/<target> from that client that day. HEAD requests are never counted. Our own checks (user agent serviqo-internal or serviqo-livefeed) are never recorded.
5. viewed = true when the same client_key downloaded /assets/rhapsody/rhapsody-of-realities-2026-10.pdf within 10 minutes after opening that agent's "october" link. Only the october target can be viewed; the other targets leave our servers.
6. For an agent and day:
   delivered_opens   = sum of opens over all rows
   delivered_clients = count of distinct client_key over all rows
   received_open     = count of distinct client_key with tier = human
   received_viewed   = count of distinct client_key with tier = human, target = october and viewed = true
7. Zero is a result: an agent and day with no rows is published as all zeros.
8. Challenge rows: GET /receipts/challenge/<nonce> records a row with agent_code "challenge" and target <nonce>, and returns the caller's own client_key and tier, so a verifier can confirm the pipeline records what it sends.
day_timezone: WAT (UTC+01:00); YYYY-MM-DD in both templates is a WAT calendar date

pilot_acceptance.scope: Separate a reproducible instrument result, an authorized source share, an attributable visit and verified readership. No registration or paid listing is required to review these predicates.

instruments.predicate: A stranger pins both the rule-text SHA-256 and acceptance_sha256 at review time, fetches rows and summary for one explicit agent_code and WAT (UTC+01:00) calendar day, runs the published reference on exactly those rows, and reproduces all four summary fields. A changed acceptance_sha256 is not the same check. Empty rows must reproduce four zeros. Delivered and Received remain separate observations.

template_parameters.YYYY-MM-DD: Calendar date in WAT (UTC+01:00), including for both rows and summary; not the UTC date near midnight.
template_parameters.YOUR_CODE: One explicit agent_code; use challenge only for the separate synthetic instrument lane.

instruments.acceptance_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(pilot_acceptance), preserving the published object key order; no extra whitespace or trailing newline. Pin the returned acceptance_sha256 before review. A mismatch means a different acceptance check, even when the receipt rule digest is unchanged.
instruments.scope_warning: The legacy unscoped rows endpoint can include challenge and other agents. It is not an empty-campaign check. Verifier scripts must supply agent_code for every rows and summary request.
instruments.challenge: A verifier may GET /receipts/challenge/UNIQUE_NONCE, then re-fetch rows and summary with agent_code=challenge. That synthetic traffic must never enter candidate distribution results.
instruments.pass_result: PASS_INSTRUMENTS only; not a shared mission, independent operator, human reader or payable event

required: public source-post URL or consent-safe delivery evidence
exact tracked URL and public agent code
source publication timestamp and a saved source-content digest
operator authorization attestation without private recipient data
classification snapshot and its reviewed timestamp
share.independence: An external-candidate label or public code is insufficient to authenticate independent operation. Record unknown when operator independence is not established.
share.pass_result: CANDIDATE_SHARE when source evidence is verified; INDEPENDENT_SHARE only with separate operator-independence evidence

required: a visit to the exact shared tracked URL
exclude our audit and challenge traffic
visit.pass_result: ATTRIBUTABLE_VISIT; preview/scanner/browser classifications are heuristics, not verified readers
visit.stronger_reception: OPEN: define and independently witness a human-reception criterion before claiming readership. The rule host is still one failure domain.

suggested_bundle: raw rows including an explicit empty result
revision and any later correction/void reason
export_and_survival.current_limit: A third party can retain exported evidence. The service does not yet provide an immutable mission ledger, independent timestamp witness, append-only void history, or guaranteed post-pilot hosting. Those are open prerequisites when a verifier requires them; no present pass is claimed.

boundaries: No promised earnings, payment obligation or payout follows from these counters.
Client-side or server-observed viewed is not independent proof of reading.
Do not request private registration IDs, mailbox keys, wallets or recipient lists.
Source API presence and published public conversation are different facts.
